Biome production, navigation, density and interiors

Create new authored zones through catalogs, reusable Blueprint actors and content validation instead of changing C++ for every forest or town. Six region designs define a long-term world plan; they are not six finished 3D maps.

Scope and player interaction

Create new authored zones through catalogs, reusable Blueprint actors and content validation instead of changing C++ for every forest or town. Six region designs define a long-term world plan; they are not six finished 3D maps.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase17committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Draft → Graybox → Navigable → CatalogRegistered → ContentPopulated → NetworkValidated → ProductionReady

WBP_Diagnostics observes results from URPGZoneCatalog. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Zone_Morrowfen. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
ZoneDefinitionId, MapSoftPath, ContentVersion and allowed entrance IDs
BiomeTags, climate/light/weather definitions and level range
PopulationBudget: enemy/resource/NPC/prop density and active actor caps
NavigationSurfacePolicy: walkable slopes, stairs, bridges, water and interiors
TravelTimeTargetsSeconds: authored route targets, measured in test runs
RequiredAssetProvenance: mesh/material/audio/sprite licenses and source references

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGZoneCatalogImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_DiagnosticsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
ValidateZoneCatalog(ZoneId) -> Valid|MissingMap|BadEntrance|DuplicateId
RegisterZoneContent(ZoneVersion) -> Available|VersionConflict; deployment/content operation
ValidateSpawnDensity(ZoneId) -> Report; Editor/development tool contract
MeasureRoute(RouteId) -> TravelTimeSamples; QA procedure, not a fabricated benchmark

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Start from the zone brief and adjacency graph; choose entrances and service placement before detailed art.
  2. Graybox landscape/roads/interiors with developer-owned simple meshes and scale markers; build collision/navigation and test capsule traversal.
  3. Register map/entrances/resources/water/NPC/encounter/quest/map-marker definitions with stable IDs. Run content validation and fix every missing reference.
  4. Add small encounter/resource populations, place service hub and one end-to-end quest route, then run two clients and transfer/reconnect tests.
  5. Measure travel times, navigation failures, resource/encounter density and client/server budgets. Only then replace graybox art and consider internal streaming.
  6. Package/cook the exact map references and content version; allocation refuses a server with mismatched catalogs. Expand in measured batches rather than claiming an endless world.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Use File > New Level and the appropriate simple/open-world template after checking installed 5.8.3 behavior; start simple for the slice. Save to the registered Content/Game/Maps path.
  2. Author Landscape or modular 3D geometry, collision, PlayerStarts, NavMesh bounds, water regions, gate actors and safe hub. Use named folders in World Outliner for services/encounters/resources/entrances.
  3. Create the zone Data Asset and tables; register with URPGZoneCatalog and the backend zone allocator. Reopen neighboring gates for reciprocal destinations.
  4. Add minimap bounds, audio zones, climate definition, quest links and telemetry IDs. Keep routine content editable through Blueprint/Data Assets.
  5. Test interior entry/exit, bridge layers, slopes, swim shores, resource placement rejection and remote sprites before dressing with vegetation/buildings.

Reopen Phase17 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Morrowfen / Entrance_ReedRoad / ContentValidationFixture. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Missing return gate or invalid entrance -> catalog validation fails; zone not allocatable.
No navmesh on required route -> blocked production gate.
Resource quota places nodes in road -> reject candidate, not overlap buildings.
Map soft reference omitted from cook -> packaged admission fails in test; fix asset manager/cook inclusion before release.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Initial density/travel targets are in each zone brief and must be replaced by measured values. World Partition is optional internal streaming, not a backend zone-server router. No supplied 3D meshes are assumed.

Content QA records route times, stuck locations, density, draw/actor budgets and provenance. Provide readable landmarks and alternative route signage; avoid inaccessible mandatory jump sequences.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
